Michelle (People Ops): Quick Q — can ppl confirm the process for promotions + comp changes this quarter? Trying to prep managers for calibration.
Jamal (Eng Manager): Do managers still need skip-level sign-off before the form? or is manager + director enough?
Michelle (People Ops): Manager + Director is the baseline for leveling recs. Skip-level sign-off is required for any title change to Senior/Principal or comp increases >10%.
Alyssa (Director, Eng): Confirmed. Also please flag "scope change" notes when moving to Sr/Principal — short bulleted rationale helps in calibration.
Jamal (Eng Manager): For comp increases, what's the approval path? Manager -> Dir -> Finance -> Exec? Any threshold stops at Dir?
Max (Finance): Approval flow: <=10%: Manager -> Director -> People Ops. 11%-25%: +Finance review. >25%: Exec comp committee review. All offers with sign-on or equity changes need Finance loop too.
Michelle (People Ops): Timeline notes: submit the promotions form by the 1st of the month for an effective date the 1st of next month. We can do retro pay up to 30 days, but must document effective date in the form.
Jamal (Eng Manager): Where's the form today? I only see the old spreadsheet link.
Michelle (People Ops): New promotions form: https://redwood.internal/hr/promotions-form — use that one. The sheet is archived; if you only have spreadsheet access ping me and I'll add you.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Promotion submissions due by 2024-04-01T23:59 UTC for May 1 effective date.
Alyssa (Director, Eng): Quick calibration ask: please include 2-3 example deliverables and current/expected level expectations. It reduces follow-ups.
Jamal (Eng Manager): Do comp bands published somewhere? I don't want to leak confidential numbers in threads.
Max (Finance): Comp bands (redacted) live in Confluence: /finance/comp-bands. Managers get view-only. If you need numbers for offers, request via Finance with headcount ticket.
Michelle (People Ops): For external offers/market adjustments: mark as "market" on form and attach recruiter note/offer. Market adjustments >15% need Exec approval.
Jamal (Eng Manager): One more — does probationary period extension affect promo eligibility?
Michelle (People Ops): If an employee is on a performance plan or probation, promotions are paused until plan completion. Exceptions require Exec sign-off.
Alyssa (Director, Eng): Thanks — can People Ops share a short checklist we can paste into 1:1s? Managers ask the same 5 questions every cycle :\)
Michelle (People Ops): Yup — will drop a checklist and a 1-slide FAQ in #people-ops today. TL;DR: Form link, documentation bullets, approvals, deadlines, effective date rules.
Jamal (Eng Manager): Awesome, thanks Michelle :tada:
Michelle (People Ops): np — tagging @people-ops-bot to remind managers 1 week before the deadline. If any edge-case, DM me or drop in this thread.
